mn76:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
mn76:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sandako paribbājako pilakkhaguhāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
mn76:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi
mn76:3.3: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
mn76:3.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena devakaṭasobbho tenupasaṅkami.
mn76:4.1: tena kho pana samayena sandako paribbājako mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā. seyyathidaṃ:
mn76:4.2: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ purisakathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
mn76:4.3: addasā kho sandako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn76:4.5: appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddamakattha,
mn76:4.6: ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati samaṇo ānando.
mn76:4.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā kosambiyaṃ paṭivasanti ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro samaṇo ānando.
mn76:4.8: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino,
mn76:4.9: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā’ti.
mn76:4.10: atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn76:5.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena sandako paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
mn76:5.2: atha kho sandako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn76:5.3: etu kho bhavaṃ ānando, svāgataṃ bhoto ānandassa.
mn76:5.4: cirassaṃ kho bhavaṃ ānando imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya,
mn76:5.6: nisīdi kho āyasmā ānando paññatte āsane.
mn76:5.7: sandakopi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn76:5.8: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sandakaṃ paribbājakaṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
mn76:5.9: ‘kāyanuttha sandaka, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā’ti.
mn76:5.10: tiṭṭhatesā bho ānanda kathā, yāya mayaṃ etarahi kathāya sannisinnā.
mn76:5.11: nesā bhoto ānandassa kathā dullabhā bhavissati pacchāpi savaṇāya.
mn76:5.12: sādhu vata bhavantaṃyeva ānandaṃ paṭibhātu sake ācariyake dhammī kathā’ti.
mn76:5.13: tena hi sandaka suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī’ti.
mn76:5.14: evaṃ bhoti kho sandako paribbājako āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
mn76:6.1: ‘cattārome sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā, cattāri ca anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā na ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusala’nti.
mn76:6.2: katame pana te bho ānanda, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā na ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti:
mn76:7.1: idha sandaka, ekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi:
mn76:7.2: ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti,
mn76:7.3: cātummahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso yadā kālaṃ karoti paṭhavī paṭhavīkāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati. āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati , ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti,
mn76:7.9: tesaṃ tucchaṃ musā vilāpo ye keci atthikavādaṃ vadanti,
mn76:7.10: bāle ca paṇḍite ca kāyassa bhedā ucchijjanti vinassanti na honti parammaraṇā’ti.
mn76:8.1: tatra sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:8.3: ‘natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ natthi hutaṃ natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko natthi ayaṃ loko natthi paro loko natthi mātā natthi pitā natthi sattā opapātikā natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti,
mn76:8.4: cātummahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso, yadā kālaṃ karoti paṭhavī paṭhavīkāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti.
mn76:8.5: āsandi pañcamā purisā mataṃ ādāya gacchanti, yāva āḷāhanā padāni paññāyanti,
mn76:8.9: tesaṃ tucchaṃ musā vilāpo ye keci atthikavādaṃ vadanti,
mn76:8.10: bāle ca paṇḍite ca kāyassa bhedā ucchijjanti, vinassanti, na honti parammaraṇāti.
mn76:8.11: sace imassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, akatena me ettha kataṃ, abbusitena me ettha vusitaṃ,
mn76:8.12: ubhopi mayaṃ ettha samasamā sāmaññaṃ pattā, yo cāhaṃ na vadāmi: ‘ubho kāyassa bhedā ucchijjissāmi vinassissāma, na bhavissāma parammaraṇā’ti.
mn76:8.13: atirekaṃ kho panimassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ, yohaṃ puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ,
mn76:8.14: sohaṃ kiṃjānanto kiṃpassanto imasmiṃ satthari brahmacariyaṃ carissāmi,
mn76:8.16: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:9.1: ayaṃ kho sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena paṭhamo abrahmacariyavāso akkhāto yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:10.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka idhekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi:
mn76:10.2: ‘karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socayato socāpayato kilamato kilamāpayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musābhaṇato, karato na karīyati pāpaṃ
mn76:10.3: khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo
mn76:10.4: dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo,
mn76:10.5: uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento natthi tato nidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo,
mn76:10.6: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo’ti.
mn76:11.1: tatra sandaka viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:11.2: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi:
mn76:11.3: ‘karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socayato kilamayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musābhaṇato karato na karīyati pāpaṃ. khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
mn76:11.4: dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
mn76:11.5: uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento natthi tato nidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo,
mn76:11.6: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamoti.
mn76:11.7: sace imassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, akatena me ettha kataṃ, abbusitena me ettha vusitaṃ.
mn76:11.8: ubhopi mayaṃ ettha samasamā sāmaññaṃ pattā yo cāhaṃ na vadāmi, ‘ubhinnaṃ kurutaṃ na karīyati pāpa’nti.
mn76:11.9: atirekaṃ kho panimassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ, yohaṃ puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ.
mn76:11.10: sohaṃ kiṃjānanto kiṃpassanto imasmiṃ satthari brahmacariyaṃ carissāmi,
mn76:11.12: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:12.1: ayaṃ kho sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dutiyo abrahmacariyavāso akkhāto, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto vā na ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:13.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka idhekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi:
mn76:13.4: natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā,
mn76:13.6: natthi balaṃ natthi viriyaṃ natthi purisatthāmo natthi purisaparakkamo,
mn76:13.7: sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā aviriyā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā chassevābhijātisu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti.
mn76:14.1: tatra sandaka viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:14.3: natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya. ahetū appaccayā sattā saṅkilissanti.
mn76:14.4: natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā. ahetū appaccayā sattā visujjhanti.
mn76:14.5: natthi balaṃ natthi viriyaṃ natthi purisatthāmo natthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā aviriyā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā chassevābhijātisu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti.
mn76:14.6: sace imassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, akatena me ettha kataṃ, abbusitena me ettha vusitaṃ.
mn76:14.7: ubhopi mayaṃ ettha samasamā sāmaññaṃ pattā, yocāhaṃ na vadāmi, ubho ahetū appaccayā visujjhissāmā’ti.

mn76:15.1: ayaṃ kho sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena tatiyo abrahmacariyavāso akkhāto, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:16.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka idhekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi:
mn76:16.2: ‘sattime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā.
mn76:16.3: te na iñjanti na viparinamanti. nāññamaññaṃ vyābādhenti. nālaṃ aññamaññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
mn76:16.5: paṭhavīkāyo āpokāyo tejokāyo vāyokāyo sukhe dukkhe jīve sattime.
mn76:16.6: ime satta kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā.
mn76:16.7: te na iñjanti, na viparinamanti, nāññamaññaṃ vyābādhenti, nālaṃ aññamaññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
mn76:16.8: tattha natthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā.
mn76:16.9: yepi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati. na koci kañci jīvitā voropeti.
mn76:16.11: cuddasa kho panimāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhiñca satāni cha ca satāni. pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca, dvaṭṭhi paṭipadā, dvaṭṭhantarakappā, chaḷābhijātiyo, aṭṭhapurisabhūmiyo, ekūnapaññāsa ājīvasate, ekūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ekūnapaññāsa nāgāvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā, satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, sattasupinā, sattasupinasatāni, cullāsītimahākappuno satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
mn76:16.12: tattha natthi imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā aparipakkaṃ vā kammaṃ paripācessāmi, paripakkaṃ vā kammaṃ phussa phussa byantīkarissāmīti.
mn76:16.13: hevaṃ natthi doṇamite sukhadukkhe, pariyantakaṭe saṃsāre, natthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, natthi ukkaṃsāvakaṃse.
mn76:16.14: seyyathāpi nāma suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhiyamānameva paleti,
mn76:16.15: evamevaṃ bāle ca paṇḍite cā sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantīti.

mn76:18.1: ayaṃ kho sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena catuttho abrahmacariyavāso akkhāto yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto cā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:19.1: ime kho te sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vesanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn76:20.1: acchariyaṃ bho ānanda, abbhutaṃ bho ānanda,
mn76:20.2: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro abrahmacariyavāsā vasamānā abrahmacariyavāsāti akkhātā yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn76:20.3: katamāni pana tāni bho ānanda, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāri anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti:
mn76:21.1: idha sandaka ekacco satthā sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti:
mn76:21.2: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti.
mn76:21.3: so suññampi agāraṃ pavisati, piṇḍampi na labhati, kukkuropi ḍasati, caṇḍenapi hatthinā samāgacchati, caṇḍenapi assena samāgacchati, caṇḍenapi goṇena samāgacchati, itthiyāpi purisassapi nāmampi gottampi pucchati, gāmassapi nigamassapi nāmampi maggampi pucchati.
mn76:21.4: so kimidanti puṭṭho samāno suññaṃ me agāraṃ pavisitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pāvisiṃ. piṇḍaṃ ෙma aladdhabbaṃ ahosi, tena nālatthaṃ. kukkurena ḍasitabbaṃ ahosi, tenamhi daṭṭho. caṇḍena hatthinā samāgantabbaṃ ahosi, tena samāgamaṃ. caṇḍena assena samāgantabbaṃ ahosi, tena samāgamaṃ. caṇḍena goṇena samāgantabbaṃ ahosi, tena samāgamaṃ. itthiyāpi purisassapi nāmampi gottampi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pucchiṃ. gāmassapi nigamassapi nāmampi maggampi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tenāpucchinti.
mn76:22.1: tatra sandaka viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:22.2: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā sabbaññū sabbadassāvī …pe… ahosi. tenāpucchinti.
mn76:22.4: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:23.1: idaṃ kho sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena paṭhamaṃ anassāsikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ akkhātaṃ, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:24.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, idhekacco satthā anussaviko hoti anussavasacco.
mn76:24.2: so anussavena itihitiha paramparāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti.
mn76:24.3: anussavikassa kho pana sandaka, satthuno anussavasaccassa sussutampi hoti, dussutampi hoti. aññathāpi hoti. aññathāpi hoti.
mn76:25.1: yatra sandaka viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:25.2: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā anussaviko anussavasacco. so anussavena itihitiha paramparāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti,
mn76:25.3: anussavikassa kho pana satthuno anussavasaccassa sussutampi hoti, dussutampi hoti, tathāpi hoti, aññathāpi hoti.
mn76:25.5: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:26.1: idaṃ kho sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dutiyaṃ anassāsikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ akkhātaṃ, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:27.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, idhekacco satthā takkī hoti vīmaṃsī.
mn76:27.2: so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayampaṭibhānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
mn76:27.3: takkissa kho pana sandaka, satthuno vīmaṃsissa sutakkitampi hoti, duttakkitampi hoti, tathāpi hoti, aññathāpi hoti.
mn76:28.1: tatra sandaka viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn76:28.2: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā takkī vīmaṃsī.
mn76:28.3: so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayampaṭibhānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
mn76:28.4: takkissa kho pana satthuno vīmaṃsissa sutakkitampi hoti, duttakkitampi hoti, tathāpi hoti, aññathāpi hoti.
mn76:28.6: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:29.1: idaṃ kho sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena tatiyaṃ anassāsikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ akkhātaṃ yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya. vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:30.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, idhekacco satthā mando hoti momūho.
mn76:30.2: so mandattā momūhattā tathā tathā pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācā vikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ,
mn76:30.3: evampi me no, tathāpi me no, aññathāpi me no, notipi me no, no notipi me noti.
mn76:31.1: tatra sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati.
mn76:31.2: ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā mando momūho,
mn76:31.3: so mandattā momūhattā tathā tathā pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ.
mn76:31.4: evampi me no, tathāpi me no, aññathāpi me no, notipi me no, no no tipi me noti.
mn76:31.6: iti viditvā tasmā brahmacariyā nibbijja pakkamati.
mn76:32.1: idaṃ kho sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena catutthaṃ anassāsikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ akkhātaṃ, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto cā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:33.1: imāni kho sandaka, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāri anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni, yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn76:34.1: acchariyaṃ bho ānanda, abbhutaṃ bho ānanda,
mn76:34.2: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāri anassāsikāneva brahmacariyāni anassāsikāni brahmacariyānīti akkhātāni. yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya, vasanto vā nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:34.3: so pana so bho ānanda, satthā kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn76:35-42.1: idha sandaka, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā. so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ …pe… sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti …pe… majjhekalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto. …pe…
mn76:35-42.2: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn76:35-42.3: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn76:35-42.4: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:43.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn76:43.2: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:44-45.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn76:44-45.2: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:46.1: puna caparaṃ sandaka, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn76:46.2: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:47.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn76:47.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbe nivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn76:47.3: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:48.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn76:48.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn76:48.3: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn76:49.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn76:49.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn76:49.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn76:50.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn76:50.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn76:50.4: yasmiṃ kho sandaka, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati. tattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vaseyya, vasanto vā ārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn76:51.1: yo pana so bho ānanda, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto. paribhuñjeyya so kāmeti.
mn76:51.2: yo so sandaka, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto. abhabbo so pañcaṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ:
mn76:51.3: abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevetuṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ, abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agāriyabhūto.
mn76:51.4: yo so sandaka, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto. abhabbo so imāni pañcaṭhānāni ajjhācaritu’nti.
mn76:52.1: yo pana so bho ānanda, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto. tassa carato ceva tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ:
mn76:52.4: upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
mn76:52.6: tassa carato ceva tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ
mn76:52.11: api ca kho pana taṃ paccavekkhamāno jānāti:
mn76:52.13: evameva kho sandaka, yo so bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto. tassa carato ceva tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ khīṇāca
mn76:52.15: api ca kho naṃ paccavekkhamāno jānāti:
mn76:53.1: kīva bahukā pana bho ānanda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye niyyātāroti.
mn76:53.2: ‘na kho sandaka, ekaṃ yeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni. atha kho bhiyyova ye imasmiṃ dhammavinaye niyyātāro’ti.
mn76:53.3: acchariyaṃ bho ānanda, abbhutaṃ bho ānanda,
mn76:53.4: na ca nāma sadhammokkaṃsanā bhavissati, na paradhammāvasādanā āyatane ca dhammadesanā. tāva bahukā ca niyyātāro paññāyissanti.
mn76:53.5: ime panā’jīvakā puttamatāya puttā. attānañceva ukkaṃsenti, pare ca vambhenti. tayo ceva niyyātāro paññapenti. seyyathidaṃ:
mn76:54.1: atha kho sandako paribbājako sakaṃ parisaṃ āmantesi:
mn76:54.4: itihidaṃ sandako paribbājako sakaṃ parisaṃ uyyojesi bhagavati brahmacariyeti.
